exposure: Maternal age (20-34 years vs 35 years and over)
cohort: 10,611 nulliparous women with planned vaginal delivery and spontaneous labor at term
finding: Advanced maternal age was not associated with an increased intrapartum cesarean delivery rate for nulliparous women at term in spontaneous labor.
mod_finding: The study found that advanced maternal age was not associated with an increased intrapartum cesarean delivery rate among nulliparous women at term in spontaneous labor.
